purpose: Investigate exact and perceptual overlap without model predictions; grouping is a leakage control, not proof of acquisition-scene independence.
exact: SHA256 of encoded bytes and decoded grayscale; compare all labels within pixel-equivalence groups
pair_search: all unordered pairs of pixel-distinct representatives, no top-k truncation
group_rule: connected components of exact equivalence and qualifying perceptual edges
annotation_conflicts: exclude whole conflicting pixel group from any proposed new protocol; retain and report originals
selection_policy: Dataset diagnostics may guide feasibility of a new split before training; no AP used to select grouping or split. No guarantee of scene independence without metadata.
